name: Kurama
source:
Estimated Age: Around 28 years old

A back-alley doctor who works out of a clinic behind 'Cafe Tsukikage'.
Though he works out of a back-alley he does have great skills.
He's stubborn and a lover of rationalism.
He doesn't deal with other people and usually works alone.
His hobby is making miniatures.
